name: Dark-Elf City, Moatside
desc1: A wide, rocky chasm splits the ground here. Ten feet down, the crack
desc2: is filled with a moat of black, noxious water. Shadowy forms swim
desc3: beneath the surface but you can only guess what they are. Attached
desc4: by chains as thick around as an ogre's arm is a lowered drawbridge. On
desc5: the other side stands a massive gate, which blocks passage to an
desc6: ominous castle. Your only other exit is north and the road into town.
